framing: H1 and H2 are CONFIRMATORY-AFTER-THE-FACT / POST-HOC: their statistics were already seen in v0.2.1 (the week-1 death experiment was a read-only feasibility gate run before this document existed; inherent design limitation). Only H3 and the one-time fold-10 analysis are genuinely prospective; locking THOSE is the purpose of this document.

H2.statement: after controlling for age/sex, adding device/site/nurse does not change fold-9 macro-AUROC by a practically relevant amount
H2.comparison: B3_physio_plus_acquisition vs B1_physio, delta = B3 - B1, seed 42 refit

tests.difference_test: 0 inside the 95% percentile CI of the paired delta -> no statistically significant difference; otherwise significant difference (sign, magnitude)
tests.equivalence_test_TOST: 'practically negligible' only if the ENTIRE 90% percentile CI of the paired delta lies within [-SESOI_H2, +SESOI_H2]; otherwise 'inconclusive / not shown negligible'
tests.achieved_equivalence_bound: max(|lower_90|, |upper_90|): smallest margin at which TOST passes

LogisticRegression.difference_test_verdict: no statistically significant difference between B1 and B3

HistGradientBoosting.difference_test_verdict: significant difference: B3 higher than B1 by +0.0199 (point delta)

learner_disagreement: difference test: LogisticRegression -> 'no statistically significant difference between B1 and B3'; HistGradientBoosting -> 'significant difference: B3 higher than B1 by +0.0199 (point delta)'
TOST: LogisticRegression -> 'practically negligible'; HistGradientBoosting -> 'inconclusive / not shown negligible'

SESOI_H2_note: chosen by the researcher on 2026-10-01 AFTER v0.2.1's deltas were visible, consistent with H2's confirmatory-after-the-fact status; lenient relative to the ~0.01 spread between published architectures on PTB-XL superclasses (0.926-0.937); achieved_equivalence_bound is reported so readers can apply their own margin
learner_rule: disagreement is reported, never resolved by selection

MDE.deviation_note: N_BOOT=2000 reuses v0.2.1's exact scheme; the original plan specified 10,000 -- stated, logged deviation.
MDE.note: MDE is a power quantity (smallest true effect detectable at 80% power on this eval set). It is NOT a decision threshold; see Part C.

stopping_rule: decisions use the CI of the PAIRED delta distribution, never overlap of two separate CIs

kill_criterion_week3.verbatim: metadata-only macro-AUROC <= 0.55 AND acquisition contribution after age/sex < MDE
kill_criterion_week3.annotation: first condition already false (H1 passed, 0.697); second condition is superseded by the TOST rule and is no longer a decision criterion anywhere in the project; recorded for completeness

H3.statement: adding acquisition metadata (device, site, nurse) to a signal model that already receives age and sex does not materially CHANGE -- inflate OR deflate -- held-out macro-AUROC

H3_protocol.comparison: signal_plus_physio [age, sex] vs signal_plus_all [age, sex, device, site, nurse]
H3_protocol.metadata_fusion: metadata vector, encoded exactly as in v0.2.1 (encoder fit on training folds only), concatenated to the network's global-pooled embedding before the final linear classification head
H3_protocol.architecture_rule: disagreement is reported, never resolved by selection
H3_protocol.development: weeks 4-5: train folds 1-8, validate fold 9; all hyperparameters AND number of epochs fixed there
H3_protocol.final_run: train folds 1-9 with those fixed settings, no early stopping, no tuning; fold 10 evaluated exactly once
H3_protocol.primary_estimate: per-record probabilities averaged over the 3 seeds, then macro-AUROC; per-seed results secondary
H3_protocol.test: paired patient-level bootstrap on fold 10, N_BOOT=2000, BOOT_SEED=7, delta = macro_auroc(signal_plus_all) - macro_auroc(signal_plus_physio)

decision.a: 95% CI excludes 0 -> 'acquisition metadata changes performance' (report sign; either direction counts)

H3_protocol.SESOI_H3_note: comparable to the spread between published architectures on PTB-XL superclasses; an effect this size could reorder them. Fixed BEFORE any signal model is trained.
H3_protocol.exploratory: any analysis not specified here (ablations, per-class results, other block comparisons) is EXPLORATORY

notes.fold9_as_proxy: Fold 9 is a STATED PROXY for fold 10's sampling variability (fold 9: 2,183 records / 1,942 patients; fold 10: 2,198 records).
notes.temporal_confounding: Temporal confounding: v0.2.1 B5_all (B3 + recording_year) ~= B3 (LR 0.6969 vs 0.6972; HGB 3-seed mean 0.6935 vs 0.6937) -> the temporal covariate adds nothing material on the metadata-only side; this does NOT address H3.

self_sha256_procedure: Load the JSON file; remove the key 'self_sha256' (the key must be absent, not empty); serialize the remaining dict with json.dumps(d, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(',', ':')); compute SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes; the hex digest must equal the stored 'self_sha256'. (At write time numpy scalars were converted to plain JSON types first, so the loaded file hashes identically.)
